messages:
taylor.nguyen: hey team, i'm starting today — thanks for having me! quick blocker: my onboarding invite went to my personal email (taylor@acontracts.co) and when i try to redeem the Okta link it errors with 'email mismatch'. who should i ping to get a contractor alias or another invite? :wave:

mike-it: welcome taylor! pinged. can you paste the exact error text? also, do you have a contractor domain we should use (some companies provision guest accounts under a contractor subdomain)?

taylor.nguyen: error shows: \"Email doesn't match org settings\". the company I'm contracting for gave me a domain (acontracts.co) but they said we should use contractor-specific addresses like firstname.lastname@acontracts.co — i only gave my personal email initially.

sara-people-ops: hi taylor, welcome! people-ops here. contractors need a managed guest in Google Workspace + an Okta guest account. we also need a signed contract on file before we can create the managed identity. jamie — can you confirm the contract is in gql?

jamie-smith: confirmed — signed SOW uploaded earlier today (see drive/eng/onboarding/sow-taylor.pdf). go ahead and provision. :+1:

mike-it: thanks. i'll reissue the invite to a contractor-scoped account. can you confirm the preferred address for Redwood systems (e.g., taylor.nguyen@acontracts.co)? once i send the new invite it should match the org rules. i'll also add you to the onboarding groups so you get drive + repo access.

taylor.nguyen: yes please use taylor.nguyen@acontracts.co. thanks!

okta-bot: automated message — New Okta invite created for taylor.nguyen@acontracts.co by mike-it at 2024-12-05T09:18:20Z

mike-it: invite resent. you should see an email from okta-noreply@redwood.com with subject \"Activate your Redwood account\". note: contractors are created as \"guest\" org users which have slightly different device trust rules — if you hit any device trust/enrollment loops, try an incognito window first.

(10m later)

taylor.nguyen: got the new invite, followed the link, okta asks to enroll MFA but fails after i click \"start\" — says \"device not allowed\" and won't let me continue. tried incognito like you said, same result. :disappointed:

mike-it: that usually means device trust is enforcing company-managed devices only for that flow. two options: 1) we can temporarily disable device trust for your guest account so you can enroll one-time, or 2) we create a short-lived bootstrap token and a manual device enrollment. i'll try option 1 first.

mike-it: done — device trust relaxed for taylor.nguyen@acontracts.co for 30 mins. try again now. :lock:

taylor.nguyen: ok enrolled MFA successfully and finished activation. thanks! i can see the company drive link but still don't have access to the project repo (gitlab).

mike-it: adding you to gitlab group 'eng-contractors' now. should be sync in ~2 mins. also filed a 1password seat request with people-ops (contractors get limited vault access).

sara-people-ops: filed the 1Password invite and added note about restricted vaults. you should get an email from 1password with steps; if you need emergency secrets access reply here and we'll create a temporary share.

taylor.nguyen: saw the git access come through, can clone now. 1password invite arrived too — everything working. huge thanks to everyone. :tada:

jamie-smith: welcome aboard, taylor. ping me if you need anything during your first week — we'll do a quick sync at 3pm PT.

mike-it: closing loop on provisioning. if anything else pops up, mention @mike-it and we'll triage. :thumbsup:

okta-bot: automated message — User taylor.nguyen successfully enrolled MFA at 2024-12-05T09:45:12Z
